name: Half-Wave Dipole
description: The half-wave dipole is the fundamental HF antenna, consisting of two quarter-wave legs fed at the center. It provides a predictable radiation pattern, moderate gain, and excellent efficiency when installed at a reasonable height.
modelingNotes: Height above ground strongly affects takeoff angle.
Inverted-V configuration lowers feed impedance and broadens bandwidth.
End effects shorten the required physical length.
Wire diameter influences bandwidth and Q factor.
Dipoles exhibit a bidirectional pattern broadside to the wire.
